# Phase 6A: Metric Definition Audit

## Metric definition audit

- F1 = full Cartesian Frobenius norm.
- F_MP_SVD = MP-reported plain 3x6 Voigt SVD scalar; **not** called maximum longitudinal modulus.
- F3 = true directional longitudinal maximum, computed deterministically.
- F4 = Kelvin/Mandel operator norm of the piezoelectric tensor as a linear map on symmetric strain.

| metric          | formula                           | physical_interpretation                                   | rotation_invariant                                  | source_field                        | version_dependent             | allowed_use                                 |
|:----------------|:----------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------|:------------------------------------|:------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------|
| F1_Frobenius    | ||e||_F                           | Full Cartesian rank-3 tensor Frobenius norm               | Yes                                                 | No (computed from stored Cartesian) | Low (conversion convention)   | Primary cross-source physical invariant     |
| F_MP_SVD        | sigma_max(3x6 Voigt matrix)       | Largest singular value of MP-reported Voigt matrix        | No (Voigt-matrix property, not Cartesian invariant) | Yes (MP e_ij_max)                   | Yes (MP parser/emmet version) | MP database-native supplemental metric only |
| F3_Longitudinal | max_{||n||=1} |n_i e_ijk n_j n_k| | True collinear longitudinal piezoelectric response        | Yes                                                 | No                                  | Low (algorithm tolerance)     | Primary cross-source physical invariant     |
| F4_KelvinOp     | sigma_max(A_K)                    | Induced-polarization operator norm in Kelvin/Mandel basis | Yes                                                 | No                                  | Low (basis convention)        | Primary cross-source physical invariant     |
